Source information is captured from frontline systems, documents, transactions, images, or conversations and then processed with cloud services that classify, summarize, model, or route the data for downstream use. data_flow: Source data is captured from frontline systems or content, processed by the Microsoft-based workflow, stored in a shared business or analytical layer, and then surfaced back to staff through apps, dashboards, or case-management experiences.
business_outcome: This partnership drives towards a future of sustainable manufacturing, leveraging Microsoft Cloud for Manufacturing and Microsoft Copilot to drive efficiency and competitive operation.
metrics: By standardizing unstructured data, LS ELECTRIC gleans detailed insights into energy consumption, leading to a 20% reduction in power use on some manufacturing lines and integrating systems for better decision-making.

Wook-Dong Cho reports, “LS ELECTRIC has reduced power consumption by about 20% to certain manufacturing lines.” Continuous monitoring of power consumption allows LS ELECTRIC to identify energy leaks and optimize operations.
